description: Etsy Product Research: etsy/store Query API.

beginFavorites.description: The number of store collections (starting), and the ending value form the upstream favorites

beginFavoritesWeekly.description: The store adds new favorites in the week (start), which together with the end value form the upstream favorites_weekly

beginReviews.description: The number of store reviews (starting), which together with the ending value form the upstream reviews

beginReviewsWeekly.description: Added reviews for the store week (start), which together with the end value form the upstream reviews_weekly

beginSales.description: The total sales volume of the store (starting), and the ending value form the upstream sales

beginSalesWeekly.description: Store weekly sales (start), which together with the end value form the upstream sales_weekly, such as 10,100

beginStoreOpenedAt.description: The start of the store opening time interval (YYYY-MM-DD), and the end date form the upstream start_at, such as 2020-01-01~2023-01-01

endStoreOpenedAt.description: The store opening time interval ends (YYYY-MM-DD)

pageSize.description: Number of items per page, maximum 100

searchKey.description: Search keywords or store name, store URL

sortBy.description: Sorting field sort_by: 8=total sales, 9=weekly sales, 10=number of comments, 11=number of collections

sortDesc.description: Sorting direction (corresponding to upstream desc): 1=descending order, 0=ascending order
